clue.text: Squash lemons with gravity
Plan to turn up huge pastries?
Dance in place, for some souls
Dessert regimen is disrupted, eating that last bite of gateau
Between south and north, fly a little bit
Supreme Council of the Armed Forces conceding defeat — or support
Stylish nanny at first engrossed by chubby baby
The Nation's note covering a feeble letter from Greece's uprising
No stringed instruments make powerful weapons
Notice someone from Seinfeld coming back
BA for soccer player
God: new or ancient character?
They break the rules relating to electric guitars
Work briefly with the left on solidarity and chance for progress
Loudly ride fast, either north or south — that's one way to find out what people are thinking
Favor playing sexy and fast
Mineral found in most alcohol
Tech lover disassembled vehicle
Ram a lousy Ford model that's apt to catch fire
Manufacture inside West Bank, finally
Drawings I curate after changing sides, put into words
Texting: "Are you wearing leather in a winter sport setting?"
Fifty in rear, fifty in front of retreating antelope with disease
Herb is a man's name
First of tailors interrupts Lord Wimsey, e.g.
Tatum mysteriously clutching belly
Sandwich covered with salsa and guacamole, flipped in a ball
Paint error — to wit, leaving a piece off the end
Hidden quality of inverted mesh in frilly surrounding
Old Testament in Russian? No! Later, perhaps
